handler.words: Seven functions added to the reporting-gold handler; the five names the order requires are all present. run() takes chain=None, builds the oldest owed filled day with run_filled_day and invokes itself for the next owed day through invoke_next_day when a chain is given; it no longer calls filled_stage, which stays defined. lambda_handler routes an event carrying a day key (and no backfill key) to run_day_event, which builds only that day. The existing lines changed are the run() signature, the population block of run() (now filled_population), the filled-stage call (now owed_filled_days and run_filled_day) and the lambda_handler body.

behavior.words: Verified by the new tests in test_filled_per_day.py (landed day is a no-op; oldest owed day is built first; no invoke when none is owed; chain links the next owed day; no earlier stage on a day event; chain None never invokes) and by the amended test test_stage_runs_after_the_class_and_lot_stages, which asserts the scheduled run runs the class and lots stages, then the owed and oldest filled day, and does not call filled_stage.

iam.resource_form: The single resource is the function's own ARN, built in words as the lambda ARN prefix in the us-east-1 region, the caller account from the existing account data source, the function segment and the name from the builder module module.irpt_reporting_gold_lambda_name (the same construction the OwnLogStreamOnly statement uses for its log group). No literal name and no wildcard.
iam.words: One new statement is added to the reporting-gold role policy document, after OwnLogStreamOnly. It is the only statement carrying a lambda action. Nothing is applied; the grant takes effect only at the applier's apply under a signed pair.

expected_plan.words: The expectation is the order's own (0 add, 2 change, 0 destroy on these two resources). Nothing was planned: this worker has no terraform binary and ran no plan. Inferred only.

files_changed.kind: handler edited (additive; six existing lines changed or removed)
